objective: Verify remediation of the completed initial M1 review without treating source-only evidence as physical NFC acceptance.
owner_requirements: Offline vendor-neutral Android app with no Internet permission
OFD catalog identity and provenance survive local edits and catalog replacement
Custom and decoded records retain understood temperatures and do not fabricate missing facts
Recents remain usable after source catalog removal
Write intent is immutable; ambiguous existing tag data is never silently discarded
Interrupted or uncertain writes remain UNKNOWN with read-only reconciliation and no automatic retry
Only Motorola Razr 2023 via wireless ADB may be used for runtime acceptance
source_digest_basis: SHA-256 of work/m1/source-SHA256SUMS; every listed entry was reverified against the final source before handoff
remediation_summary: UserDatabase v2 adds a non-destructive v1 migration for temperature values, retained catalog identifiers/colors, record provenance, and per-field sources.
Catalog edits persist under a stable edited:<original package ID> key with an original-package link. Unchanged field sources remain OFD and changed values become Edited locally.

Decoded tag seeds retain nozzle, bed, diameter, weight, and additional colors. Product and color-name labels may remain blank; missing diameter or mass blocks write preparation rather than being fabricated.
Recent snapshots now contain complete understood record values, sources, identifiers, temperatures, and colors and are selectable in the UI.
CatalogDatabase v2 stores generation metadata and recomputes a deterministic digest across every persisted row before trusting a same-count catalog.
The generator handles string and array color_hex forms, retains all secondary colors, and maps sizes.article_number explicitly.

The NFC coordinator rejects multiple records and non-OpenSpool existing content before write, preserves UNKNOWN across reconciliation I/O failures, and provides an explicit durable unresolved archive before a new operation.
UNKNOWN no longer exposes a no-op Cancel action. The UI uses compact profile labels, non-colliding detail rows, human field names, a light status bar, global NFC status, and selectable recents.
The coordinator executor is shut down from MainViewModel.onCleared().

worker_evidence.core_catalog_compilation: PASS using cached Kotlin compiler, no Gradle bypass

host_evidence_required_before_submission: Room exported v2 schema inspection and migration validation from saved installed v1 user.db baseline
Final source, APK, manifest, test, and lint digests/results
known_unverified: Android app compilation and lint after remediation
UserDatabase and CatalogDatabase v1 to v2 migration on Android
Physical NTAG215, PAXX, U1, independent-reader, interruption, and p95 acceptance
review_questions: Do v1 to v2 migrations exactly preserve installed user data while matching Room v2 schemas?
Can any edit, restart, catalog reinstall, or recent-snapshot path still lose a temperature, retained identifier/color, or per-field source?
Can any ambiguous NDEF or reconciliation failure reach a write, false VERIFIED state, erased UNKNOWN state, or automatic retry?
Does the generated catalog now represent primary colors, secondary colors, and article numbers without fabricated defaults?
Are the UI flows complete and accessible enough for the required Razr 2023 runtime acceptance?
